_comment: Provider rate card for usage-audit.pl. Rates change; re-verify against the source URLs and bump rates_verified when you do. All model prices are USD per 1M tokens unless noted.

anthropic._note: List rates. Cache read = 0.1x input, cache write (5m TTL) = 1.25x input. Subscription plans are not token-metered; these rates price the workload's notional API value only.

zai._note: Credits = (input*in + cached*cached + output*out) / 10000. No cache-write tier exists, so Anthropic cache_creation is billed as full input. Off-peak = 50% of standard rate. Peak = Mon-Fri 14:00-18:00 SGT (UTC+8) == 06:00-09:59 UTC.

deepseek._note: Pay-per-token; no subscription, no rate governor. Anthropic cache_creation is billed as cache_miss. A 2x peak surcharge (09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing, daily) is drafted but not in effect as of rates_verified.

kimi._note: Metered in REQUESTS per rolling 5h window, not tokens. Moonshot does not publish numeric per-tier quotas; the documented Kimi Code range is ~300-1200 requests per 5h with up to 30 concurrent. Compared against the peak-5h request count rather than tokens.
